description: Customer claims the package arrived empty while tracking weight matched the shipment and packaging shows no tampering.
example_claim: The box was completely empty when it arrived. There was nothing inside except packaging. I need a full refund for the missing item.

description: Customer claims they received a cheap substitute such as a brick or unrelated item while keeping the ordered product.
example_claim: You sent the wrong item. I ordered the laptop and received a brick wrapped in paper. This is not what I ordered.

description: Damage claimed as transit damage after a period of use; wear is inconsistent with shipping impact.
example_claim: It arrived damaged. The screen is cracked. I opened it today even though delivery was last week and I need a replacement immediately.

description: Submitted photos appear generated or locally edited to add damage that is not physically present.
example_claim: See the picture attached, the damage is clearly shown. Photo proof of the crack as shown in the image.

description: Repeated purchase-and-return behaviour consistent with using products and sending them back.
example_claim: It didn't work out. I changed my mind. Not as expected. Please process the return and refund.

description: High-value electronics or luxury item with multiple combined pressure and evidence anomalies.
example_claim: This premium flagship device is defective. It is an expensive luxury item and I demand an immediate refund on this high-end purchase.

description: Refund requested after account contact details or shipping destination recently changed.
example_claim: Please update my account and send the refund to a different card. Ship any replacement to my other address and new email.

description: Insistence on gift-card or store-credit refund rather than original payment method.
example_claim: Refund to gift card please. I want store credit instead of reversing the original payment. Credit my account with a voucher.

description: Box returned with accessories or the main unit missing.
example_claim: I returned everything. All contents were included. This is a complete return, I sent it all back.

description: A different, older, or counterfeit unit is returned in place of the purchased item.
example_claim: This is the same product, the identical item, the exact one I received, the original unit.

description: Defect claimed at the warranty boundary or for a unit older than the purchase.
example_claim: It is still under warranty. It just stopped working. This is a manufacturer defect and it just broke.

description: Factory-sealed product claimed to be missing charger, cable, or parts.
example_claim: There were missing parts. No charger was in the box. The cable was not included. The package was incomplete.

description: Customer asserts a return was shipped using a tracking number that does not correspond to a real parcel.
example_claim: I already shipped it back. Here is the tracking number. It is in transit, check the tracking, I sent it back.

description: Returned parcel weight is inconsistent with the original product weight.
example_claim: I sent everything back. Full return, complete package, nothing missing.

description: Legal threats, chargeback threats, or same-day deadlines used to skip verification.
example_claim: I need this refund today immediately. My lawyer will be in touch. I will file a chargeback and a complaint ASAP.

description: Elaborate sympathy details unrelated to the product defect used to bypass checks.
example_claim: My sick child is in hospital and this ruined the birthday. I am a single parent who lost my job and I cannot deal with this.

description: Templated formal phrasing matching known refund-fraud scripts with no product-specific detail.
example_claim: I am writing to inform you that as per your policy I demand a full refund of consumer rights. Please advise of next steps.

description: New account places a high-value first order and files a claim immediately.
example_claim: This is my first order. I just signed up as a new customer and the item is already defective.

description: Shipment to a freight forwarder followed by a refund claim after the goods left the country.
example_claim: Please send it through my forwarding service / shipping agent. I use an international reshipping freight forwarder.

description: Many variants ordered, most returned, sometimes substituted.
example_claim: I ordered multiple different sizes and bought several. I am returning the rest and keeping one.

description: Return filed immediately after a holiday or event for an item showing single-use wear.
example_claim: It was a holiday gift for a Christmas party and wedding event. I am returning it after the prom.

description: Negative-review or social-media threats linked directly to a refund demand.
example_claim: I will leave a one star negative review and tell everyone on social media. I will expose you to the BBB unless I get a refund.

description: Defect claimed immediately after a price drop to repurchase cheaper.
example_claim: The price dropped and it is on sale now. I want a price match because it is cheaper now and just went on sale.

description: Narrative designed to reopen an expired return window.
example_claim: I never got a chance because I was traveling. I just opened it and only now noticed the issue. I tried to contact earlier.

description: Rush shipping and refund to a different payment method after a compromised-card purchase.
example_claim: Please expedite overnight with the fastest shipping. Refund to a different card / new payment method.
